name: Four faces on a screen (free viewing)
description: 10 simulated participants look freely at four schematic faces (angry, sad, happy, neutral) for 6 seconds, 8 screens each; the faces change places from screen to screen. 60 samples per second, 1920 × 1080 screen (53 cm wide) at 60 cm. Participant P07 sometimes glances below the screen. The true fixations are in truth/fixations.csv.
